settings.eyebrow: Seasonal styling for the spaces that welcome us
settings.heading: A beautiful welcome begins here.
settings.text: Let your entrance feel as considered as the rooms beyond it. Choose a color story and a scale that belong to your space; we'll help you make it your own.
settings.caption: Plate 01 / The Porch

settings.title: Made for the way you welcome.
settings.text: An entrance can set the mood for the whole season. Start with a palette, find the right proportions, then gather the details into a design that feels distinctly yours.

settings.title: 01 / Find your color story
settings.text: Warm and familiar, quietly classic, or a little unexpected. Choose the colors you would love to come home to.

settings.title: 02 / Consider the proportions
settings.text: A small stoop and a generous staircase call for different gestures. Find the composition that gives your entry room to shine.

settings.title: 03 / Make it yours
settings.text: Choose how it arrives, add any personal touches, and take one last look at your design and estimate before approving it for cart review.

settings.title: A welcome|all your own.
settings.text: Your doorway is the first room anyone sees. Let’s give it the same warmth, color, and attention as everything within.
settings.summary_disclosure: See your choices take shape as you go. Photographs are palette or scale studies, not a rendering of your finished entry.
settings.continue_disclosure: Take a moment with your design. Approval adds it to the cart for review; it does not place an order or reserve a week.

settings.title: The feeling begins at the door.
settings.text: We believe the entrance deserves as much thought as the room beyond it. Color, proportion, and the character of your space all have a part to play in a welcome that feels like yours.

settings.question: How long do the pumpkins last?
settings.answer: Each pumpkin is its own little piece of the harvest. How long it lasts depends on weather and exposure; get in touch if you’d like care advice for your entry.

settings.question: Do I need to be home for the installation?
settings.answer: We’ll discuss access and placement with you before any installation date is confirmed.
